g.text: The top tenth of students spend ten times what the bottom tenth spend

Source: PSLM 2019-20 person and household files. Sample: students with ed_total > 0 in KP rural (variant 4). Weighted by hhweight. Excludes 3 students outside Rs 100-Rs 1,000,000; log10 bins 0.1 wide.
